easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
There's another land on the battlefield.
description:
Play Strip Mine.
When Strip Mine enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Strip Mine.
Activate Strip Mine's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, targeting another land.
Haru triggers, returning Strip Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Strip Mine enters, Retreat to Emeria and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Strip Mine.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
